personality_one_liner: A precision intelligence console for email triage, threat detection, and machine learning explainability.

spacing.rule: Clean operational rhythm with precise padding and sticky action bars

do's: Use high contrast dividers and sharp borders
dont's: Avoid heavy blur on high density metrics screens

screens.name: Start
screens.purpose: Animated cursor grid start screen with system intelligence status and direct launch into inbox intelligence.
screens.layout: Full-bleed dark terminal aesthetic with animated pulsing grid, live feature weights ticker, and prominent orange primary CTA.

screens.name: Inbox
screens.purpose: Command center for incoming emails categorized by priority, intent, and threat score.

states.empty: Inbox fully sanitized. No priority emails pending.
states.error: Failed to sync secure mailbox stream.

screens.layout: Vertical scrollable list with filter chips (All, Priority, Phishing Alert, Action Required), threat badge indicators, and quick action row.

screens.name: Analyze
screens.purpose: Paste raw text or upload .eml, .txt, .pdf, .docx files for deep NLP and TF-IDF classical ML inference.

states.empty: Paste or upload an email payload to initiate pipeline.
states.error: File extraction or model inference failed.

screens.layout: Tabbed input interface (Paste Text / File Drop), feature configuration toggles, and sticky 'Run ML Analysis' button.

screens.name: Detail
screens.purpose: Explainable AI analysis results showing classification, TF-IDF feature weights, phishing indicators, and AI response assistant.
screens.layout: Structured modular card layout with top threat gauge, model probability distribution bars, SHAP/LIME feature weight breakdown, and generated response actions.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Browse past email analyses, classification logs, and saved response drafts.
screens.layout: Chronological card list with search filter, status tags (Spam, Safe, Priority), and quick review actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute adherence to Dark-First Utility persona. Use Barlow Condensed for numerical metrics and timers, Satoshi for body text. Implement all 5 core screens (Start, Inbox, Analyze, Detail, History) with robust Loading, Empty, and Error states. Ensure sticky primary CTA on Analyze and Detail screens. Strictly enforce zero tolerance for indigo/purple/blue/navy hues and emojis.
